references.eq1c_t4: Policy F range return cuts tangential variance 1.0 -> 0.022 and vertical 1.0 -> 0.038

definitions.camera_measurement: identity-bearing: the current RGB-D detection (appearance + depth)
definitions.lidar_association: range-only and identity-free: a LiDAR return gated against the predicted track; never resets the identity clock
definitions.fused_recency_age: existing tracker age: time since the last accepted fused update; the 5 s expiry contract is unchanged
definitions.identity_age: new diagnostic: time since the last camera (identity-bearing) update; LiDAR-only updates never reset it; not an actor input
definitions.update_source: per step: none, camera or lidar_range (evaluator-facing diagnostic)
definitions.reacquisition: identity-confirmed reacquisition = a camera update after identity_age > 0.5 s; a lidar_range update alone is fused-valid, not reacquisition

corrections.C1_radius: LiDAR association uses the LiDAR proxy radius 0.20 m: predicted surface = predicted centre range - 0.20; centre = measured surface + 0.20 (EQ-1A A4). Camera centre-range (A7) unchanged and still a Known FAIL
corrections.C2_row_eligibility: only LiDAR rows whose elevation lies within asin(0.20 / predicted centre range) of the predicted target elevation (vehicle frame) can measure the target; the measured surface is the minimum over eligible rows of the bearing-nearest column; no eligible row means no association
corrections.C3_shape_consistency: reject when an adjacent row (e +- 1) at the same column returns a horizontal range within 0.10 m of the matched return's horizontal range (a vertically extended surface the 0.20 m proxy cannot produce beyond 1.15 m), or when the predicted centre range is below 0.20/sin(10 deg) = 1.152 m (inconclusive)
corrections.C4_range_only_model: measurement point = LiDAR origin + (measured surface + 0.20) * u, u = unit vector to the predicted centre; R = 0.08^2 u u^T + 50^2 (I - u u^T) (EKF H = u^T)
corrections.C5_identity_clock: tracker keeps fused recency age (unchanged expiry) and adds identity_age plus update_source diagnostics
corrections.unchanged: camera detection and measurement, S-L1A depth, S-L1B fusion and carve, obstacle tokens, association gate width rule, tracker process model, 898-D schema, E-L0

fixtures.negative: the 7 EQ-1D D2-N2 bar-only scenes N1, N2, N3, N5, N6, N7, N8 with the track primed at the bar front + 0.15 m along association_beam_deg, camera lost
fixtures.positive: every D2/extra target scene whose bearing-nearest LiDAR column has an oracle-eligible row hitting the 0.20 m proxy unoccluded, with predicted centre >= 1.152 m; track primed at the true centre (and at +-0.15 m range offsets), camera lost
fixtures.cpu_exact: analytic LiDAR scans from the float64 oracle: tall bars at 2-11 m and bearings 0/20/90/180 deg; target spheres at 1.5-11.5 m including a target 0.3 m in front of a bar and a target between two bars; range-only covariance cases at bearings 0/45/90 deg and elevations 0/8 deg

gates.C-NEG: 0 of 7 bar-only negatives accepted (CPU oracle scans and GPU rendered scans); legacy 7/7 reported
gates.C-POS: every eligible positive accepted (recall 100% on the preregistered eligible set) on CPU and GPU, with centre error <= 1e-3 m for beam-centred targets; ineligible cases reported
gates.C-COV: after one range-only update, posterior variance along the two directions orthogonal to u is >= 0.99 of the prior (CPU and GPU probe) and the variance along u decreases
gates.C-PROV: update_source and identity_age: camera updates reset identity_age, lidar_range updates never do; fused age contract unchanged (expiry on the 51st miss as EQ-1C T2); evaluator-only
gates.C-RADIUS: beam-centred analytic target: centre range error <= 1e-4 m (CPU); GPU beam-centred targets <= 1e-3 m
gates.C-REGRESSION: CPU: unset/off, s_l1a_v1, s_l1b_v1 perception bitwise equal to source a1f97e9. GPU: off = EL0-R1 P2, s_l1a = SL1A-C01 on_p2, s_l1b = SL1B-C01 s_l1b_p2 (14 keys, 600 steps, static 4501 / moving 4502)
gates.C-EL0: s_l1c_v1 E-L0 P1 and P2 closed-loop digests identical
gates.C-FIREWALL: association/shape/clock code reads only LiDAR ranges, the camera visibility flag, the tracker's own state and declared constants (AST/signature test); the GT target pose/semantic id is used only by the evaluator and the fixture priming; actor 898
gates.C-INTEGRITY: checkpoint, RMS, 898-D, import origins, source SHA, frozen tree, raw manifest valid; no NaN/Inf
gates.verdict: S-L1C QUALIFIED only if C-NEG, C-POS, C-COV, C-PROV, C-RADIUS, C-REGRESSION, C-EL0, C-FIREWALL and C-INTEGRITY all pass; one metric improving while another fails is NO-GO
